articles.mainIdea: In HelloNation, Breastfeeding Expert Patty Gatter of Emmaus, PA, Shares Tips on Breast Pump Care for Busy Parents
articles.summary: PR Newswire: In HelloNation, Breastfeeding Expert Patty Gatter of Emmaus, PA, Shares Tips on Breast Pump Care for Busy Parents. How can breastfeeding parents in Emmaus keep their breast pump clean without adding stress to their day? That question is answered in a HelloNation article featuring breastfeeding expert Patty Gatter of The Breastfeeding Shop in Emmaus, Pennsylvania. The article outlines a simple, time-saving approach to breast pump care that supports both baby health and parental peace of mind.

articles.title: Dine Brands Appoints Two Directors with Significant Industry Experience to Board
articles.mainIdea: Dine Brands Appoints Two Directors with Significant Industry Experience to Board
articles.summary: Business Wire: Dine Brands Appoints Two Directors with Significant Industry Experience to Board. PASADENA, Calif., February 03, 2026--Dine Brands Global, Inc. (NYSE: DIN) (the "Company" or "Dine Brands"), the parent company of Applebee’s Neighborhood Grill + Bar®, Fuzzy’s Taco Shop® and IHOP® restaurants, today announced that Enrique "Rick" Silva and Amanda Clark will be joining as independent members of its Board of Directors (the "Board"), effective February 4, 2026. In connection with these appointments, the Board will expand from nine members to eleven. Related tickers mentioned: DIN, PZZA.
